full_name: Linda G. Griffith | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2009–2010 Biological Sciences Harvard Stem Cell Institute Radcliffe Fellow Massachusetts Institute of Technology
bio: Linda G. Griffith is a professor of biological and mechanical engineering at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), where she holds the School of Engineering Teaching Innovation Chair.
